@Ednaldo40916743 I get it,i get it people. Its not super disclaimed as AI,but does that give you the right to swing for the fences?

Lets face it,there are some ideal scenes that you will only see through AI,because the artist tries to awaken peoples minds. 

Is it impossible that a K9 would protect its owner like this? Nope,i have experienced untrained dogs guard the family members in all scenarios,at theyr property,out in public etc. 

Trained K9s can do soo much more and be even more effective. I saw this right away as being a artistic artpiece to make people emotional,one way or another.

Its very common for AI artists. Its just another artform.
People hating on AI,is hating on technology,as AI is part of technology and its way forward. 

Like a good guy from the same community im in on Twitch said to me.  "I hate AI used for crimes etc,but i love your videos!" Me: "You love generative AI". Him: "Yes,i love what you do,that part of AI i got nothing against".

And i was with him,i worry about non-generative AI or content-AI as i call it,but generative-AI is for entertainment purposes only,and there i hope creativity will be the main priority in the years to come,because if used right,it can be the best way to honor someone,pay tribute etc. I see sadly where abuse of generative-AI (creating dead celebrities doing political,provocative stuff has caused families of the dead celebrities to react,AI models change,and those AI models drop in popularity and die...." Sora 2 was one of the absolute best models,then the backlash caused them to only allow "non human generated scenes". 

Lets just take a breather when we see AI like this,and appreciate it for what it is. I agree,we as AI artists can be better at disclaiming it as just that,AI.

But also,people can be better then to throw shade at serious AI content creators. You dont know the amount of work that is done ahead of scenes like this. 

I saw a UFC fight between Gollum (LOTR) and Brock Lesnar. The Artists admitted that the generation process wich is the EASIEST part of the job,took him 9 HOURS!

Imagine what he used combined in creating scenes through image creating,cutting/clipping copy and pasting.

Not every image gets perfect on the first try either.

tweets.text:
Neuroscience versus artificial intelligence 

You want to know how lame AI vision systems are compared to humans?

Almost everyone who has seen pictures of Abraham Lincoln will recognize this image almost instantly. This is true even if they're seeing it for the first time.

A deep neural net, on the other hand, will fail to recognize the image unless it has been specifically trained to recognize it.

Why is that, you ask? It is because recognition in the brain is based on a winner-take-all mechanism that is extremely tolerant of noise and distortions. By contrast, a deep learning system is based on the statistics of connection weights. Yep, DL sucks. 😀

I love the brain. 😍
